artifact.reason: Existing Party type definition that party ideological profiles will reference. Shows naming pattern (type alias from const array) to follow for ideological axes.
Example of existing party scoring system (weight-based). Will be replaced by ideological profile system. Shows TypeScript const object pattern and structure to consider when designing new system.

constraints.constraint: Module Organization: New directory src/lib/ideology/ must house all ideological matching logic. Maintains separation from existing src/lib/ modules (questions, parties, categories).
TypeScript strict mode must be enabled. No any types allowed in production code. All interfaces must be explicitly typed.
Use kebab-case for axis IDs (e.g., market-state). Use PascalCase for TypeScript interfaces (e.g., IdeologicalAxis). Use camelCase for exported arrays (e.g., ideologicalAxes).
types.ts is foundation module with no dependencies. Other modules in Epic 1 will depend on it.
Axis Score Granularity: Use decimals (number type) for finer granularity. Range: Standard 1-10 for all axes. Neutral midpoint: (min_value + max_value) / 2.

interface.name: IdeologicalAxis
interface.signature: export interface IdeologicalAxis { id: string; // e.g., 'market-state', 'individual-collective' name: string; // Display name description: string; // Explanation of the axis min_value: number; // Minimum score (e.g., 1) max_value: number; // Maximum score (e.g., 10) min_label: string; // Label for min end (e.g., 'Market-oriented') max_label: string; // Label for max end (e.g., 'State-oriented') }

tests.standards: Testing Framework: Vitest (v3.0.4) configured via package.json script "test:unit". Tests co-located with source files using .test.ts suffix. Line coverage target: 85%. Branch coverage target: 80%. Test all edge cases and validation logic. TypeScript strict mode for test files.

ideas.idea: T1: Verify axes load successfully - import ideologicalAxes and check array length >= 4
Schema validation - for each axis, verify all 7 required fields present (id, name, description, min_value, max_value, min_label, max_label)
Range validation - for each axis, assert min_value < max_value
ID uniqueness - check no duplicate axis IDs in array
Required axes present - verify specific IDs exist: market-state, individual-collective, progressive-conservative, ecology-economy
Type safety - npm run check must pass without errors. No 'any' types used.
Edge cases - test with empty axis array, missing fields, invalid ranges (min > max), duplicate IDs
